name: EZ Bar Preacher Curl 21s
description: A preacher curl 21s protocol using an EZ bar on a preacher bench. The preacher bench eliminates cheating by fixing the upper arm against the pad, and the 21s protocol applies partial and full-range stress to maximize bicep time under tension.

execution.starting_position: Sit at a preacher bench with the upper arms firmly against the angled pad. Grip an EZ bar with an underhand grip.
execution.setup_instructions: Set up the preacher bench. Load a light EZ bar. Position upper arms on the pad.
steps: Step 1 (reps 1-7): Curl from full extension to the halfway point (forearms parallel to floor). Return and repeat 7 times.
Step 2 (reps 8-14): Start from the halfway point and curl to full contraction. Return to halfway and repeat 7 times.
Step 3 (reps 15-21): Perform 7 full-range reps from full extension to full contraction.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale on each curl, inhale on each lowering.
common_mistakes: Lifting the upper arms off the pad to assist the movement
safety_considerations: Upper arms must remain on the pad throughout — the pad is the stabilizer
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Full extension (arms straight) in segment 1. Full contraction in segment 2 and 3.
coaching_cues: Upper arms stay on the pad
Feel the bottom stretch in segment 1
